verdict.rationale: Slack's docs confirm a no-code Workflow Builder with triggers (including external webhook triggers) and conditional branching, directly matching the admin no-code workflow story. However, the evidence pack doesn't explicitly document schedule-based triggers or form-submission triggers (only webhook and generic 'triggers'), leaving part of the story unconfirmed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule-triggered workflows, explicit documentation of form-submission-triggered workflows, independent/hands-on corroboration of Workflow Builder's ease-of-use.
